title: Menus, choices and meters on Base UI
items: The request list's menu (right click, the keyboard's menu key or a long press) and the body's Copy menu work from the keyboard: arrow keys move through them, Enter picks, Escape closes, and the dashboard's shortcut keys leave an open menu alone. Like the browser's own, the right-click menu closes on a click outside without acting on it
Pick-one choices (filters, body and preview views, theme, plan, ticket category and rating) are one stop for Tab, and the arrow keys move the choice
The dashboard guide's sections are tabs: the arrow keys move between them
On phones, the docs contents keep focus inside while open, and once closed no longer hold links Tab could reach
Usage bars are announced as meters
